name: Ògún (Yoruba)

domain_history.domain: expanded to new iron/steel-adjacent technologies over time

notes: Sandra T. Barnes, ed., Africa's Ogun: Old World and New (Indiana UP, 1989/1997) — standard scholarly edited volume on the deity's transformations across West Africa and the Americas. A popular (non-academic) claim that Ògún was "a real person, an Ifè king" could NOT be verified against any academic source — contrast with Ṣàngó below, where historicization is well-attested in academic literature; do not treat the Ògún-as-historical-king claim with the same confidence.
